svg.title: Account value and leaderboard rank, SIG Predictions Cup 2026
svg.desc: Account value rose from 100,000 at the open on 1 October to about 437,000 after four days, then slowly to about 600,000; rank went from 29th on day one to 8th of 1,969 at the close.
svg.text: SIG leaderboard value (100,000 start + profit), New York time. Dashed end: the board a day after the close, once most markets had settled.
